sloka: ततः स रोषताम्राक्षः शशास सचिवांस्तदा ।गृह्यतामेष दुर्मेधा वध्यतामिति चासकृत् ।। ६.४१.८२ ।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa roṣatāmrākṣaḥ śaśāsa sacivāṁstadā ।gṛhyatāmeṣa durmedhā vadhyatāmiti cāsakṛt ।। 6.41.82 ।।।।

translations.english: "Unless you return back Vaidehi respectfully, bowing down to me you will be killed and Vibheeshana will get the fortune."
